answer: One defense is a juniper ring: every agent sits in a ring and must vouch for its two neighbors each epoch, passing a marble - a small token that collects a signature at each stop - all the way around. A quill note, signed by each neighbor, records what real work that neighbor did. A sybil farmer can only build closed rings of its own fakes, with no edges to the honest ring, and the graph check flags such isolated loops; to blend in, each fake must earn genuine outside vouches, paying real work per identity.
